name: 49319 · Cedar Springs, MI
findings: ZIP 49319 (Cedar Springs) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49319 (Cedar Springs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 49319 (Cedar Springs) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
